items.before: The gate clears gate-result-<phase>.json once, when it starts, and writes it when it ends. gate-wait returns whatever file appears at that path. Nothing ties a result to the run that is being waited on: no pid, no start-time token, no lock on the logs folder. Stages that repeat reuse one folder: the ladder always writes to logs/<id>-ladder, fix rounds to logs/<id>-fix, and recoverDownStack reruns a stage into the same folder. GATE_WAIT_RULE tells the agent to report "the gate did not finish" as red after 20 waits but never to stop the gate, so that gate keeps running.
items.after:
The gate clears gate-result-<phase>.json once, when it starts. It writes the file when it ends.

gate-wait returns whatever file appears at that path.

Nothing ties a result to the run that is being waited on:

- no pid
- no start-time token
- no lock on the logs folder

Stages that repeat reuse one folder:

- the ladder always writes to logs/<id>-ladder
- fix rounds write to logs/<id>-fix

GATE_WAIT_RULE tells the agent to report "the gate did not finish" as red after 20 waits. It never tells the agent to stop the gate, so that gate keeps running.
